VI.description: Copies the cx x cy pixels at (x1\2C y1) of the device context hdcSrc to (x\2C y) of the device context hdc through gdi32.dll BitBlt (stdcall\2C called in any thread). With hdcSrc = user32 GetDC.vi of a window and rop SRCCOPY (0x00CC0020) this reads the window's client area as Windows composited it last - the window's own redirection surface\2C so also when it is covered by other windows (measured on Windows 11 with a LabVIEW front panel)\2C without asking the window to draw itself. return value is the Win32 BOOL\3A non-zero on success\2C 0 on failure. When error in carries an error the DLL is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.

Control.description: Destination device context (HDC)\2C e.g. a memory DC with a bitmap selected into it.
Source device context (HDC)\2C e.g. a window's DC from user32 GetDC.vi.
When this carries an error the DLL is not called and the error is passed to error out.
